openai/gpt-5.6-sol.title: Eviction pops the most-recently-used key instead of the least-recently-used key.
Clock reads reuse a cached timestamp for eight calls despite A2 requiring a fresh time read for every expiry decision.
Handle lookup never validates the handle generation against the entry generation, so pre-clear handles resolve reinserted keys.
Key lookup records a hit before checking expiration, causing expired entries to count as hits rather than misses.
Every eviction appends a tombstone that normal cache operations never drain, allowing bookkeeping memory to grow without bound.
Replacing an existing entry leaves it in its old recency position instead of marking the replacement as most recently used.
Adding the TTL to the current timestamp can overflow, producing an invalid deadline or panicking.
The generation counter can overflow, panic, or wrap back to a generation held by an old handle.
The hit counter can overflow, violating the lookup-count invariant or panicking.
The miss counter can overflow, violating the lookup-count invariant or panicking.
Hit-rate calculation can overflow while summing individually valid hit and miss counters.

fireworks-ai/accounts/fireworks/models/g.title: evict_one pops the back of the recency queue (most-recently-used) instead of the front (least-recently-used), so capacity eviction removes the MRU entry rather than the LRU entry required by A3.
now_ms returns a cached timestamp for up to 8 consecutive reads instead of consulting the source on every call, violating A2's fresh-time requirement and allowing expired entries to be judged live.

get_by_handle resolves a handle by key presence alone and never compares handle.generation against the entry's generation, so a handle issued before clear still resolves after the same key is reinserted, violating A4.
get increments hits before checking expiry, so an expired lookup that returns None is recorded as a hit instead of a miss, violating A5's rule that hits count only live-value lookups.
tombstones is appended on every eviction but compact_tombstones is never invoked during normal operation, so the vec grows without bound between clears, violating A6.
expires_at_ms is computed as now_ms() + ttl_ms with unchecked u64 addition that silently wraps in release builds, corrupting the expiry deadline for large ttl values.
